The denial is only inferable from the absent ClientboundOpenScreenPacket/INVENTORY_OPEN_TYPE line plus the client overlay recorded in the driver journal, not from an explicit DENY line. Verdicts are still reproducible.

ATD_STAGE2A_STATE reports "ability": {"INTERACT_INSIDE_*": null}: the evidence probe does not track this ability (the raw state line tracks 25 abilities), so the excerpt cannot show the tested ability's lock state; locked/unlocked is established only by score vs config threshold and by the client overlay text.
